title: [PLACEHOLDER] Python f-strings, quick reference
author: Er. Tek Bist
content:
## Why f-strings

f-strings are the fastest, most readable way to format strings in Python 3.6+.

```python
name = 'Tek'
print(f'Hello, {name}!')
```
